Short-Term Web Development & Design Intern (5–9 Weeks, Part-Time, Hybrid)


Are you looking to quickly build a standout portfolio, learn new skills, and connect with tech professionals? We are seeking a motivated Short-Term Web Development & Design Intern to join our team in Menlo Park, CA for a focused, high-impact learning experience.


This is an immediate-start, part-time, unpaid internship lasting 5 to 9 weeks (under 20 hours/week). It is designed to give you fast, real-world project experience and valuable mentorship without a long-term commitment. We are looking to fill this role immediately following a successful in-person interview.


🚀 What You Will Do


• Assist on Active Projects: Help design and update clean, user-friendly web pages.
• Build & Code: Work with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or CMS platforms to implement features.
• Learn Along the Way: Shadow team members, tackle bugs, and absorb industry best practices.


🎯 Who We Are Looking For


• Local to Menlo Park: You live close to Menlo Park, CA, and can easily come into the office for an interview and your weekly shifts.
• Eager Learner: You have basic web design or coding knowledge and want to apply it immediately.
• Ready to Start: You are available to interview in person and begin the 5–9 week placement right away.


💼 Perks & What You’ll Gain


• Rapid Portfolio Building: Gain hands-on project experience you can immediately add to your resume.
• Network Expansion: Meet and collaborate with local professionals in Silicon Valley.
• Office Comforts: Enjoy a fully stocked workspace with complimentary coffee, tea, and premium snacks.
• Total Flexibility: A short-term duration under 20 hours a week tailored to your availability.
fit_why: Unpaid short-term basic HTML/CSS role; mismatched to his full-stack experience

Todd is the first AI-powered agriculture company designed for sustainable farming, blending agronomy research with technology. We focus on balancing and remineralizing soil, improving surrounding environments and improving health through mineral rich vegetables and fruit. We explore any territory in pursuit of an idea, taking unconventional approaches and making big, bold decisions in unexpected ways. Our internships offer the chance to make a direct impact at Todd and contribute to Todd’s growth journey.


We will win for two reasons:



- There is no other company doing this (yet)
- You can tell the CEO he’s wrong


About the role:


Internships are available remotely in the US within a range of teams from marketing to technology, finance or talent to name a few. You’ll generally be with Todd for 12 weeks and be fully embedded within the team. Our teams are a mix of staff-level college students and tuff 19 yr olds.


Mentorship plays a big role for our interns too — you’ll be paired with one of our senior leaders, providing coaching and support one-to-one throughout the program.


You might be a good fit if you are:



- One of the best [fill in the blank] in the world
- Crazy cracked
- You like what you do
- Down to work for the coolest startup ever


This program does not provide monetary compensation (i.e. no pay) standard. Depending on skill, compensation is an option.


This position does not support work authorization/visa sponsorship.
fit_why: Unpaid, vague startup posting; full-stack fits but role framing is weak

role: Data Science Intern - Summer 2027 - Franklin, TN
jd:
Location(s): Franklin, TN
 Job Schedule: Full-time, 12-week program
 Degree Level: Senior or Master's
 Preferred Degree: Data Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, or related quantitative field
 Sponsorship: Not Available

 Shape the Future of Mobility at Nissan: Launch Your Career, Drive Innovation

 We are currently looking for a Data Science Intern to join our team in Franklin, TN. The TCS QSM Data Analytics team partners with business and engineering stakeholders to transform complex vehicle, warranty, aftersales, and connected vehicle data into actionable insights that improve vehicles and enhance the customer experience. Our team develops predictive models, analytical applications, and data-driven solutions that support key business decisions. This internship provides hands-on experience with modern data platforms, including Snowflake, cloud technologies, SQL, Python, visualization tools, and emerging AI capabilities while working alongside experienced analysts and data scientists on real-world business challenges.

 A Day in the Life:
 
• Clean, transform, and analyze complex datasets to uncover trends, insights, and opportunities. 
• Develop SQL queries, Python-based analytics solutions, and data-driven applications. 
• Create dashboards, visualizations, and reporting tools that support business decision-making. 
• Explore and apply machine learning and AI technologies to solve business challenges. 
• Support projects involving Connected Vehicle applications, backend data platforms, customer retention models, and customer loyalty analytics. 
 Who We’re Looking For:
 Required: 
 
• Must be currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate degree program in Data Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field. 
• Students entering their Junior, Senior, or Master's program at the start of the upcoming academic term. 
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills. 
• Experience with SQL and Python through coursework, research, personal projects, or prior internships. 
• Passion for working with data and turning information into actionable insights. 
• Interest in modern analytics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and cloud-based data platforms. 
• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences. 
• Eagerness to learn new technologies and contribute to data-driven business initiatives. 
• GPA of 3.0 or above (Candidates will be required to provide an official or unofficial transcript during the application process for verification.) 
• Ability to perform work onsite at Franklin, TN. 
 What You’ll Look Forward to at Nissan:
 Connection and Collaboration: We offer Business Synergy Teams (ERGs) and opportunities for our employees to strengthen their relationships and meet people from similar and diverse backgrounds to foster a culture of belonging.

 Professional Training and Development: Expand your knowledge and skills through Nissan’s rich innovation offerings, seminars, learning platforms and leadership trainings.

 Nissan is committed to a drug-free workplace. All employment is contingent upon the successful completion of drug and background screenings in accordance with Nissan policies and in compliance with federal, state, and local laws, including the California Fair Chance Act and the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance. Nissan will consider qualified candidates with arrest or conviction records for employment in a manner consistent with these laws. 

 It is Nissan’s policy to provide Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of race, gender, military status, disability, or any other status protected by law. Candidates for this position must be legally authorized to work in the United States and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility at the time of hire; Nissan uses E-Verify to validate employment eligibility. 

 NISSAN FOR EVERYONE 

 People are our most valuable assets, and Nissan seeks to maximize the power of each individual member of our team. When everyone belongs, the power of NISSAN is undeniable. Nissan aims to improve business results through a workplace and business that meets the needs of our employees and customer base.

 Nissan is committed to creating a culture where everyone belongs and employees, customers, and partners feel respected, valued, and heard. We have Business Synergy Teams (BSTs) across the Americas that are open to all employees and seek to connect employees through common interests and foster a company culture where all employees feel supported and included.

 Nissan also values inclusion in our business as we respect and recognize the diversity of our customer base and the communities where we do business. We are committed to procuring innovative goods and services, retailing our products, and communicating from a position that will help us continue to offer our customers competitively designed, market-driven products.

 Join us as we carry our commitment to our employees and customers into the future.

Franklin Tennessee United States of America
fit_why: Data science intern; strong Python/SQL fit, but onsite Tennessee and senior-level

P-963

 At Databricks, we are passionate about helping data teams solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business.

 As a Software Engineering Intern, you will join a team of engineers to build features that contribute directly to the Databricks platform. We're hiring across all of our teams, including full stack, backend, infrastructure, systems, tools, cloud, databases, and customer-facing products. You will have a dedicated mentor and will join our summer 2027 intern cohort where you'll connect with engineers, other interns, and leaders from across the company.

 We are hiring Software Engineering Interns across multiple offices. Please apply for the single location that you're the most interested in, and we will discuss more with you as you move through the process. We can only consider one application in 30 days. 

 The impact you will have: 

• Work with a team to build features for the Databricks platform 

• Manage your project end-to-end, including design, code, and feedback 

• Learn about building a platform that scales quickly while maintaining quality and security 
 
 What we look for: 

• You will graduate in fall 2027 or spring 2028 with a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related subject 

• You have implementation skills with a general purpose program language, such as Python, Java, or C++ 

• You have good knowledge of algorithms, data structures, and OOP principles 

• You are excited to solve ambiguous problems with a collaborative team 
 
 You can select one of the following programs through this application: Summer 16-week co-op, or Summer 12-week internship. Co-ops are only available to students enrolled in a co-op program.
